author: hubitrep
releaseNotes: 0.1.7 (beta): driver 0.2.0 finds the TV on the network: add the device and save with the IP address blank; with several TVs, pick one from the TV list. The driver remembers the TV and follows it to a new IP address after a failed connection; Find TVs searches again. After a power cut the hub may not find the TV again until it restarts, so a DHCP reservation is still the safe choice. The search needs firmware 2.5.2 or later. Tester 0.4.0 adds a Discovery test: whether the box announces itself on the network, also while off.
